outcome: patterns of management of severe and non-severe maternal morbidities
cohort: 1.583 pregnant women admitted to the governmental hospital in Ramallah, Palestine
finding: The burden of maternal morbidity for Palestinian women between the ages of 16 and 48 is high.
mod_finding: Women who gave birth by cesarean sections were three times more likely to suffer from morbidities than those who had vaginal delivery.
